original: あら
traducao: Oh,

original: ちょうど、あなたの事を\n考えていたところなの
traducao: I was just\nthinking about you.

original: 実は、個人的に\nお願いしたい事があって……
traducao: I actually have a\npersonal favor to ask...

original: 時間がある時でいいから、\nわたしの話を聞いてくれる？
traducao: Could you listen to me\nwhen you have time?

original: クエスト「行方知れずの傭兵」が\nエントリーされました。\nクエストカウンタから受ける事が出来ます
traducao: The quest "Missing Mercenary"\nhas been added.\nYou can accept it at the counter.

original: 行ってくれるのね？\nありがとう。\nとっても助かるな
traducao: You will go?\nThank you.\nThat helps me a lot.

original: 何だァ、何の闇取引の話だ？
traducao: What's this, some shady deal?

original: ○○、気を付けろよ。\nアンジュはこう見えて\n結構腹黒いんだぜ？
traducao: Watch out, ○○.\nAnge might look sweet, but\nshe's pretty wicked, you know?

original: 心外だな。\nそんな事ないと思うけど……
traducao: How rude.\nI don't think that's true...

original: それに、今の話はきちんとした依頼。\nリカルドさんを迎えに\n行ってもらおうと思って
traducao: Besides, this is a formal request.\nI'm asking them to go\nand meet Ricardo.

original: そういや、あのおっさん、\n到着遅れてるみたいだな
traducao: Come to think of it, that old man\nseems to be running late.

original: 迷子ってキャラでもねェのによ
traducao: He doesn't seem like the type to get lost.

original: だから、正式な依頼として\nお願いをしたの
traducao: That's why I made\na formal request.

original: 大丈夫だとは思うけど、\n万が一の事があるといけないでしょ
traducao: I'm sure he's fine, but\nwe can't be too careful.

original: なるほどな。\nそーいう事か
traducao: I see.\nSo that's how it is.

original: ○○、\n準備は抜かりなくしていけよ？
traducao: ○○,\nmake sure you're fully prepared.

original: 職業柄っつーか、初対面の相手に\n容赦ねェからな、あのおっさん
traducao: It's his job, but that old man\nshows no mercy to strangers.

original: そこのガキ。\n止まれ
traducao: You there, kid.\nStop.

original: ……おい
traducao: ...Hey.

original: こんな所で何をしている？
traducao: What are you doing here?

original: ……近いな
traducao: ...You're close.

original: ガキ。\n死にたくなければ、\n今すぐにここを去れ
traducao: Kid.\nIf you don't want to die,\nleave this place immediately.

original: さもなければ、命の保障は出来ん。\nいいな。\n二度は言わん
traducao: Otherwise, I can't guarantee your life.\nUnderstood?\nI won't say it twice.

original: ……少々、手間取ったか
traducao: ...That took a bit longer than expected.

original: ……まだいたのか
traducao: ...You're still here?

original: 帰れと言ったはずだ。\nここは、ガキの遊び場ではない
traducao: I told you to go home.\nThis isn't a playground for kids.

original: 何？　今、アンジュと言ったか？
traducao: What? Did you just say Ange?

original: おい。\n詳しく話を聞かせろ
traducao: Hey.\nTell me the details.

original: なるほど……。\n確かにお前の探している傭兵、\nリカルド・ソルダートとは俺の事だ
traducao: I see...\nThe mercenary you're looking for,\nRicardo Soldato, is indeed me.

original: 事情は把握した。\n俺も仕事の報告が終わり次第、\n予定通りギルドへ向かう
traducao: I understand the situation.\nOnce I report my job, I will\nhead to the guild as planned.

original: セレーナには、そう伝えてくれ
traducao: Tell Serena that.

original: ……今度はそう時間はかからん
traducao: ...It won't take long this time.

original: 俺と契約を結んでいるのは\nセレーナだけなのだ
traducao: The only one I have a contract with\nis Serena.

original: 契約は遵守する。\n……それが俺の主義でな
traducao: I honor my contracts.\n...That's my principle.

original: ああ、○○
ご苦労様。\n今、ちょうどリカルドさんと\nあなたの話をしていたところなの
traducao: Good work.\nRicardo and I were\njust talking about you.

original: また会ったな。\nしかし……、よもやこんなガキが\nギルドで依頼を請け負っているとは……
traducao: We meet again.\nBut... to think a kid like you\nis taking on guild requests...

original: 技量も人柄も確かですから。\nギルドのリーダーとしては、\n仕事を任せない理由がありません
traducao: Their skills and character are solid.\nAs the guild leader, there's\nno reason not to trust them with work.

original: ふむ……
traducao: Hmph...

original: あ……、本当だ。\nリカルドさんだ！
traducao: Ah... it's true.\nIt's Ricardo!

original: ずいぶん遅い到着じゃない〜？\nもしかして、大御所ぶってるつもり？
traducao: Aren't you arriving pretty late?\nAre you trying to act like a big shot?

original: いや、単に道に迷ってただけって\n線も残ってるぜェ？
traducao: Or maybe there's still the chance\nthat he just got lost?

original: 二人とも、ちょっと……。\n失礼だよ……
traducao: You two, please...\nThat's rude...

original: ……相変わらず騒がしい奴らだ
traducao: ...Noisy as ever, I see.

original: セレーナ、ひとまず俺は部屋で\n休ませてもらう
traducao: Serena, I'm going to my room\nto rest for now.

original: 仕事の話はそれからだ
traducao: We'll talk about work after that.

original: わかりました
traducao: Understood.

original: ああ
traducao: Yeah.

original: 言うまでもない事だとは思うが、\nガキ共とは別の部屋で頼む
traducao: It should go without saying, but\nI want a room separate from the brats.

original: っか〜〜〜、相変わらず\n無愛想な上にムカつく野郎だな！
traducao: Gah! He's as unfriendly\nand annoying as ever!

original: まぁ、それでこそのおっさんって\n気もするけどね〜
traducao: Well, I guess that's what makes\nhim the old man we know.

original: アニーミ。\nその不愉快な呼称は\n慎めと言っていたはずだ
traducao: Animi.\nI believe I told you to stop\nusing that unpleasant nickname.

original: あ〜ら、そうだったかしらぁ？\nどうもおっさんのお小言は\n右から左みたいで、ごめんなさいね〜♪
traducao: Oh my, did you now?\nI'm sorry, but the old man's nagging\ngoes in one ear and out the other!

original: はいはい。\nじゃれ合うのもそこまで
traducao: Okay, okay.\nThat's enough joking around.

original: とにかく、\n頼もしい仲間が増えたんだから。\nみんな、協力して、仲良くね
traducao: Anyway,\nwe have a reliable new ally.\nLet's all work together and get along.

original: ○○もゆっくり体を休めて。\n今日はどうもありがとう
traducao: ○○, you get some rest too.\nThank you for today.

original: リカルドがアドリビトムに加入しました
traducao: Ricardo joined Ad Libitum.
